knowledge_point.title: Identifying Correct Statements About a Matrix

question.:question/problem:
Consider the matrix

$$
A=\begin{bmatrix}4 & 0 & 0 \\ 2 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 5 & 3\end{bmatrix}.
$$

Which of the following statements are true?

Select all that apply.
question.:question/worked-solution:
- $A$ is upper triangular: **false**. The entry in row 2, column 1 is $2\ne 0$, below the main diagonal.

$$
A=\begin{bmatrix}4 & 0 & 0 \\ 2 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 5 & 3\end{bmatrix}
$$

- $A$ is lower triangular: **true**. All entries above the main diagonal are zero.

$$
A=\begin{bmatrix}4 & 0 & 0 \\ 2 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 5 & 3\end{bmatrix}
$$

- ${A}^{T}$ is upper triangular: **true**. All entries below the main diagonal are zero.

$$
{A}^{T}=\begin{bmatrix}4 & 2 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & 5 \\ 0 & 0 & 3\end{bmatrix}
$$

question.:question/problem:
Consider the matrix 
$A=[\begin{aligned}4 & 0 & 0 \\ 2 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 5 & 3\end{aligned}].$
Which of the following statements are true?

- $A$ is upper triangular
- $A$ is lower triangular
- ${A}^{T}$ is upper triangular
question.:question/worked-solution:
Let's analyze each statement in turn.

- Statement I is false, since $A$ has non-zero entries below the main diagonal:

$$
A=[\begin{aligned}4 & 0 & 0 \\ 2 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 5 & 3\end{aligned}]
$$

- Statement II is true. All the entries above the main diagonal of $A$ are zeros:

$$
A=[\begin{aligned}4 & 0 & 0 \\ 2 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 5 & 3\end{aligned}]
$$

- Statement III is true. All the entries below the main diagonal of ${A}^{T}$ are zeros:

$$
{A}^{T}=[\begin{aligned}4 & 2 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & 5 \\ 0 & 0 & 3\end{aligned}]
$$

Therefore, the correct answer is "II and III only".

$$

$$

- $B$ is lower triangular: **false**. The entry in row 2, column 3 is $-1\ne 0$, above the main diagonal.

$$
B=\begin{bmatrix}2 & 0 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & -3 & -1 & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & 4 & 5 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 2\end{bmatrix}
$$

- $B-{B}^{T}$ is upper triangular: **false**. The entry in row 3, column 2 is $1\ne 0$, below the main diagonal.

$$
B-{B}^{T}=\begin{bmatrix}0 & 0 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & -1 & 1 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & 5 \\ 0 & -1 & -5 & 0\end{bmatrix}
$$
